label: Qwen3.8 27B
params_summary: 27B · 64 layers · hybrid linear attention (Gated DeltaNet 3:1 full) · +1 MTP block
notes: PROMOTED 2026-08-20 (T14 phase B). available=true and the file now sits in models/ alongside the rest, so scripts/model_manifest_check.py cross-checks it against src/common/model.c and client/src/models.ts. The onboarding prerequisites of hard constraint #2 are both on record: the real-machine ppl gate (test-assets/ppl/qwen3.8-27b.Q4_K_M.json -- PPL 1.9780 +/- 0.05305 on a unified-memory Linux node at the b10502 pin, identical across 3 runs, G_PPL_OK) and the testbed smoke. Evidence: results/t14-engine-bump-phaseb-20260820.md.

Architecture: the GGUF declares general.architecture = 'qwen35' -- Qwen3.8-27B is a Qwen3.5-27B-shaped model, not a new architecture. Every geometry field below was read from THIS model's own GGUF header (scripts/measure_gguf.py --meta) and matches qwen3.5-27b.json exactly: 5120 embd, 24 q heads / 4 KV heads x 256, full_attention_interval 4, ssm inner 6144 / state 128 / group 16 / conv 4, ff 17408, vocab 248320, ctx 262144, rope base 1e7. The KV numbers are therefore carried over rather than re-derived: full layers 4 x 256 x 2 x 4 B = 8192 B/token/layer; linear layers 48x128x128x4 + 3x10240x4 = 3268608 B of state, context-independent.

MTP / n_layers: qwen35.block_count is 65 in most community quants, because block 64 is an MTP (NextN) draft head, not a decode layer. n_layers here is 64 -- the planner splits decode layers, and counting the MTP block as one would mis-size every node. MTP is NOT present in every precision of this repo: IQ1_S / IQ1_M / IQ2_XXS / IQ2_S ship block_count 64 with no MTP at all; everything from Q2_K_XL up carries it at ~335 MiB (Q4_0 253, Q4_1 275, Q8_0 430, Q8_K_XL 543 -- the MTP head is quantised on its own schedule). Per-precision measurements: results/t14-qwen38-manifest-draft-20260819.md.

layer_weight_bytes carries the WHOLE file size and shared_weight_bytes is 0 -- the same convention as every other manifest here (the planner only uses their sum, and shared_weight_bytes is charged to every node, which would over-count a cluster). The real split is measured and recorded in the results file rather than guessed; e.g. UD-Q4_K_M is 14,344,308,736 B across blk.0-63, 351,008,768 B of MTP, 1,758,126,080 B shared.

Source: unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF, revision 990216c. Chosen over bartowski/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF (also reputable, imatrix-calibrated) because it matches the qwen3.5-* manifests already in this tree, and because its low end reaches IQ1_S -- which is the part of the ladder that decides whether a 16 GiB discrete GPU can hold this model at all. bartowski remains the fallback if the phase-B ppl gate prefers imatrix quants.

Multimodal: upstream Qwen3.8-27B is image-text-to-text and both repos ship mmproj files. They are deliberately NOT listed -- v2 does not do multimodal (hard constraint #2). Text-only serving is unaffected; the chat template simply never emits vision tokens.

Thinking model: the template turns reasoning on by default and injects a 'Reasoning effort is set to xhigh' system line. The sidecar's `--reasoning off` default already covers the known failure mode (whole max_tokens burnt inside <think>), but this model's default effort is the highest of the three it accepts, which is worth a look during the phase-B smoke.
The GGUF carries the publisher's sampling recommendation: temp 1.0, top_k 20, top_p 0.95.

deployment=single-node, RESOLVED 2026-08-20 (phase B); the draft said cluster and flagged it for measurement, and the draft was wrong. 'Follows the other llamacpp-backed manifests' conflated backend with deployment: the llamacpp models are clustered because they are 200-850 GB, not because they are llamacpp. Backend and deployment are independent axes. Every manifest here under ~11 GB is single-node, and this model's default (IQ1_S) is 6.2 GB -- smaller than qwen3.5-35b-a3b at 10.7 GB. Marking it cluster would also fight hard scheduling rule #8, 'if it fits, do not go over the network'. The planner unit test caught the mistake directly: with deployment=cluster, 'extra machines do NOT unlock a single-node model' went red. Q4_K_M at 16.46 GB remains the interesting rung for a 16 GiB discrete card, and the T8 resolve path sizes it to 1 sequence slot there -- the same answer it gives qwen3.5-27B Q4_K_M at 16.74 GB (src/tools/plan_test.c, 'T3 replay: 27B Q4_K_M on the 16 GiB card').
Every byte count, sha256 and the revision come from the HF API and from HTTP Range reads of the file headers. No weights were downloaded to the control machine.

Gate coverage, stated plainly so nobody assumes more than was measured: the ppl band covers Q4_K_M, which is the precision the gate ran on. default_quant is IQ1_S -- the smallest rung, chosen the same way qwen3.5-27b defaults to IQ2_XXS, so the model reaches the most machines. That default is NOT ppl-gated, and IQ1_S is exactly the precision where quantisation damage would show first. Gating it needs its own download and its own band; until then the honest statement is that Q4_K_M is verified and the low rungs are inherited convention.
